faqList.a: One ForAll lists every item of the post on the preview card; tick the photos and videos you want and you get ONE ZIP containing exactly those items. For a single video on its own, choose MP4/MP3 with exactly one video tile - one file can only be built from one video.

faqList.q: Why do the video tiles have no thumbnail?
faqList.a: Threads does not publish a cover image per video in a post (measured: a three-video post carries one image for the whole post), so video tiles show their position instead of reusing the post cover for all three.

faqList.q: Which version of the video do I get?
faqList.a: Exactly the MP4 that Threads itself publishes to visitors on the post's embed page (measured: 720x1280 portrait, H.264/AAC). One ForAll does not upscale it, does not fake a 1080p or 4K tier, and shows no video quality selector because the platform publishes only one version.

faqList.q: Is the downloaded image altered in any way?
faqList.a: One ForAll does not crop, upscale or filter: the file keeps the size the post declares. When the platform serves a WebP for a single-image post, the tool converts it to JPEG at the same size before handing it over; inside a ZIP the photos keep their original format untouched. If the received file does not match the declared size, the tool aborts and reports an error instead of handing you a different file.

howItWorksSteps.title: Download the new archive

features.title: Safe extraction
features.desc: Archive entries are checked for path traversal and entry-count/size limits before anything is unpacked.

features.title: Common formats covered
features.desc: Convert ZIP to TAR or 7Z, and TAR or TAR.GZ to ZIP.

features.title: Temporary file handling
features.desc: Source and result archives are cleaned up under the platform storage policy.

faqList.q: Can I convert RAR or 7Z to ZIP?
faqList.a: No. The current tool accepts ZIP, TAR, and TAR.GZ inputs. It can create 7Z output from ZIP.

faqList.q: Are very large archives supported?
faqList.a: Processing is limited to 2,000 file entries and 512 MiB of uncompressed file data. Archives above those limits are rejected.

faqList.q: Are archive filenames and folders preserved?
faqList.a: File paths are used when files are repacked. Empty directories and archive metadata may not be preserved.
